title: Maximal graded subalgebras of simple vectorial Lie superalgebras with polynomial coefficients
summary: S. Lie was the first to try to classify maximal subalgebras of simple vectorial (i.e., consisting of vector fields) Lie algebras with polynomial coefficients. In Appendix it is shown that, as stated, the problem is wild: describing all subalgebras contains the classification of pairs of matrices up to simultaneous conjugation, so there are too many such subalgebras. Several researchers distinguished various classes of maximal subalgebras important in applications. Here, in simple (or in Cartan prolongations close to simple) vectorial Lie superalgebras with polynomial coefficients considered…
